blocks.prompt: 5. Resolve into partial fractions: \(\frac{6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7}{2x^2 - x - 1}\) [printed as \(5x2\) in the numerator]
blocks.explanation:
Upar degree 3 aur neeche degree 2: improper fraction.
Is liye pehle long division karenge, phir remainder ko \((x - 1)(2x + 1)\) par Case I se todenge.
Plan: long division, denominator ke factors, identity, \(A\) aur \(B\), tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7}{2x^2 - x - 1}\) (kitab mein \(5x2\) chhapa hai; matlab \(5x^2\) hai)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Improper fraction = quotient + remainder/denominator. Phir proper hissa Case I se. Numerator mein \(x\) wala term nahi hai; long division mein us ki jagah \(0x\) samajh kar chalein taake columns ghalat na hon.

Long division
\[6x^3 \div 2x^2 = 3x\]
\[3x(2x^2 - x - 1) = 6x^3 - 3x^2 - 3x\]
Tafreeq: \(8x^2 + 3x - 7\)
\[8x^2 \div 2x^2 = 4\]
\[4(2x^2 - x - 1) = 8x^2 - 4x - 4\]
Tafreeq: \(7x - 3\)
Kyun: Har baar pehle terms ko divide karo, wapas multiply karo, aur minus karo. Jab remainder ki degree (1) divisor ki degree (2) se kam ho jaye to ruk jao.
Dhyan dein: Tafreeq karte waqt poore bracket ke signs badalte hain: \(5x^2 - (-3x^2) = 8x^2\) aur \(0x - (-3x) = 3x\).

Division ka nateeja likhein
\[= 3x + 4 + \dfrac{7x - 3}{2x^2 - x - 1}\]
Kyun: Quotient \(3x + 4\) aur remainder \(7x - 3\). Ab sirf remainder wala hissa todna hai.

Denominator ke factors banayein
\[2x^2 - x - 1 = 2x^2 - 2x + x - 1\]
\[= (x - 1)(2x + 1)\]
Kyun: Middle term todne ka tareeqa: \(2 \times (-1) = -2\), aise do numbers jin ka zarb \(-2\) aur jama \(-1\) ho: \(-2\) aur \(+1\). Phir grouping se \(2x(x - 1) + 1(x - 1)\).

Shakal aur identity likhein
\[\dfrac{7x - 3}{(x - 1)(2x + 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{2x + 1}\]
\[7x - 3 = A(2x + 1) + B(x - 1) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Do mukhtalif linear factors; \((x - 1)(2x + 1)\) se multiply kar ke fractions khatam kar diye. \(2x + 1\) ke saath 2 laga hai, lekin shakal phir bhi wohi hai: upar sirf ek constant.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[7 - 3 = A(3)\]
\[A = \tfrac{4}{3}\]
Kyun: \(x - 1 = 0\), to \(B\) wala term ghayab.

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) rakhein
\[-\tfrac{7}{2} - 3 = B\left(-\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\]
\[-\tfrac{13}{2} = -\tfrac{3}{2}B\]
\[B = \tfrac{13}{3}\]
Kyun: \(2x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) milta hai. Factor ka zero hamesha poora integer nahi hota; fraction rakhne se ghabrayein nahi. \(-\tfrac{1}{2} - 1 = -\tfrac{3}{2}\).

Coefficients compare karein
\[x:\ 2A + B = \tfrac{8}{3} + \tfrac{13}{3} = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ A - B = \tfrac{4}{3} - \tfrac{13}{3} = -3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: (i) kholein to \((2A + B)x + (A - B)\) banta hai, jo \(7x - 3\) ke barabar hona chahiye. Dono baraabar nikle, to constants sahi.

Jawab likhein
\[= 3x + 4 + \dfrac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \dfrac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\]
Kyun: Quotient aur remainder ke partial fractions dono mila kar poora jawab.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\[\dfrac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \dfrac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{4(2x + 1) + 13(x - 1)}{3(x - 1)(2x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{21x - 9}{3(2x^2 - x - 1)} = \dfrac{7x - 3}{2x^2 - x - 1}\]
Phir \((3x + 4)(2x^2 - x - 1) + 7x - 3\)
\[= 6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7x - 4 + 7x - 3\]
\[= 6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Fractions jor kar remainder wapas mila, aur quotient guna divisor jama remainder se asal numerator wapas aa gaya. Yeh division ki bhi tasdeeq hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein numerator \(6x^3 + 5x2 - 7\) chhapa hai: power 2 line par gir gayi hai. Durust \(6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7\) hai, aur answer key ka jawab \(3x + 4 + \frac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \frac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\) bhi isi ki tasdeeq karta hai.
